actual.description: Expected lang attribute on the root element, but got nothing. The html element must have a lang attribute, where the content is composed of a 2-letter ISO 639 language code, followed by the appropriate ISO 3166 geography code. You can use html lang='[language code]-[country code]'. Example: html lang='en-us', where 'en' refers to the language and 'us' refers to the geography.
